linux.post_install: unpack() { if unzip -tq "$1" > /dev/null 2>&1; then unzip -oq "$1"; else tar -xf "$1"; fi rm -f "$1" } # Hytale server files need a signed-in Hytale account, so they cannot be # downloaded without a person. This gets the official downloader only. curl -fL --retry 3 -o hytale-downloader.zip https://downloader.hytale.com/hytale-downloader.zip unzip -oq hytale-downloader.zip hytale-downloader-linux-amd64 QUICKSTART.md rm -f hytale-downloader.zip chmod +x hytale-downloader-linux-amd64 echo "Hytale: run ./hytale-downloader-linux-amd64 once in this folder and sign in to download the server files."
